title: Alternative HDB or JTC Sites for Small Businesses whose Premises are Destroyed by Fire
what_it_is: Alternative HDB or JTC Sites for Small Businesses whose Premises are Destroyed by Fire

sections.label: HDB and JTC fire assistance
sections.summary: HDB takes over affected factory premises, repairs them, grants rent remission, and can allocate transitional units, while JTC helps find alternative units and gives case-by-case rental remission.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, in the case of factory units, HDB will take over the affected premises and carry out architectural and structural repair works.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will also grant rent remission to the tenants of the affected units from the date of fire until the date the units are reinstated and handed back to the tenants to resume business operations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: During the period of rectification works, if the tenant needs alternative units to continue their operations, HDB can allocate available vacant factory units, known as transitional units, to the tenant for temporary occupation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Similarly, JTC will assist by looking for alternative factory units while the affected premises are being repaired.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, they provide rental remission on a case-by-case basis.
